purpose: Exercise every branch of INV-D07. The declared negative seed reaches one of four; the other three would otherwise be asserted rather than demonstrated (P9).
method: each case built on its own disposable copy of production, evaluated through the framework probe (python -m verification _inv_json --db)

branches.condition: reservation still overpaid beyond the threshold, resolution empty
branches.note: the balance is what decides, not the resolution field
production as it stands, 2 rows, both resolution=income
violates even when a resolution is present - referential failure is not excusable by explanation

materiality_boundary.reading: below the 1.00 threshold this rule reads the reservation as not overpaid and calls a truthful record baseless
above the threshold the record matches a live overpayment

r5_consequence: Below 1.00 INV-A06 and INV-D07 disagree about whether an overpayment exists. INV-A06 excludes the reservation from its population; INV-D07 reports its log row as unbacked. Production escapes only because both live rows carry resolution=income. This is the measured argument that R-5 needs a decision rather than a default.
population_note: population is the overpayment_logs table, which is what makes this the converse of INV-A06 rather than a restatement of it. On production it is 2, so the rule is NOT VACUOUS.
